subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly via Guangzhou to Harbin for the Songhua River, St. Sophia Cathedral Square and Ice and Snow World. Fly on to Mohe, China’s northernmost town, to visit Northeast Tiger Park, a reindeer park and North Pole Village’s Christmas Village, Asia’s only Christmas-themed park. Hotels are 5-star in Harbin and Mohe and 4-star in North Pole Village. A no-shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 16–21 2026 to Dec 14–19 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Songhua River: The river running through Harbin, a winter promenade along its frozen banks.
placeDesc.Middle East Railway Bridge: A historic railway bridge over the Songhua River, built in the early 20th century.
placeDesc.Harbin Flood Control Monument: A monument on the Songhua riverside in Harbin, commemorating the city's 1957 flood defence.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's famous pedestrian street with European-style buildings, shops and cafes.
placeDesc.St. Sophia Cathedral Square: The square in front of Harbin's well-known Russian Orthodox church.
placeDesc.Ice and Snow World: A large winter park in Harbin with giant ice and snow sculptures, lit up in the evening.
placeDesc.Northeast Tiger Park: A park in Harbin where Siberian tigers can be viewed from a vehicle.
placeDesc.Mohe Dance Hall: A local evening entertainment stop in Mohe, the northernmost city in China.
placeDesc.Reindeer Park: A park in the Mohe area where visitors meet and photograph gentle reindeer.
placeDesc.North Pole Village: A village in Mohe, in far northern China, known for its polar location and winter scenery.
placeDesc.Christmas Village: A Christmas-themed park with Santa's House, the Christmas Post Office and Santa Claus Square.
placeDesc.Songyuan Park: A primeval forest park in Mohe.
placeDesc.May 6th Fire Memorial Hall: A memorial in Mohe about the 1987 Great Xing'an Mountains forest fire.
placeDesc.Polaris Square: A viewpoint square in Mohe overlooking the mountain city and its natural landscape.
